verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Watchlist reports that check an applicant against sanctions, PEP, monitored-list and adverse-media sources. That is a point-in-time screen. Nothing shows previously verified users being automatically re-screened when watchlists update. The webhooks cover workflow status changes, not ongoing-monitoring match events, and "Monitored Lists" names a list category, not continuous monitoring.

support.subject: As an ops lead, screening is not one-shot — previously verified users are continuously re-screened against watchlist updates, and changes raise events I can act on
